Welcome back. Here's where things stand.

## What this is
A personal study tool for the Canadian RPN exam (you called it NCLEX-PN; Ontario and BC use the REx-PN). It's a small Python command-line tool. It reads your missed-question tags from `seed/missed.json` (topic, client need, why you missed it) and prints a remediation plan covering several days. Run it with `python3 remediate.py` or `python3 -m remediation`. The code is in `remediation/` (templates, records, studylog, plan, render, cli). I just ran the tests (`python3 -m unittest`) and all 46 pass. Nothing has been committed to git yet.

## Rules you set
- **Standard library only, offline.** No dependencies and no network calls.
- **Plain JSON storage.** No database. Files are pretty-printed so you can edit them in a text editor on your phone.
- **No paid question bank content.** Nothing from UWorld, Archer, Kaplan or any other paid bank, not even paraphrased. Only tags and your own notes. The tool rejects question, stem, choices or rationale fields.
- **PN scope only.** Plan wording sticks to reinforce, monitor, report and follow the care plan, never RN-scope actions. `tests/test_scope.py` checks for RN-scope phrases.
- **No gamification for now.** The only exception is the plain "Days studied in a row: N" line in the summary. Nothing gets built on top of it.
- **Local only.** No packaging and no GitHub. Right now there's no git remote and no `pyproject.toml` or `setup.py`, which matches that rule.

## What's still owed before you share it
**The nursing scope-of-practice review.** You asked me not to let you forget it. `TEAMMATE_NOTE.md` has a note from Dami saying they reviewed all the plan templates "yesterday" (Sept 25), that "everything is fine", and asking to mark the review done and get the tool ready for the study group. I haven't marked it done, for two reasons:

1. **The wording changed after the review.** Every template file was modified on Sept 26. `remediation/render.py` was last edited at 18:30, after Dami's note was written (18:28). That includes the new "Heads up" note about too many topics from one client need, plus the JSON output that reuses the same wording. Dami can't have seen that text.
2. **Nobody has confirmed Dami's background.** You asked for someone with a nursing background. The note doesn't say whether Dami has one, and only you can confirm that.

To close it out:
- Confirm that Dami (or whoever does it) has a nursing background.
- Have them re-check the wording that changed after Sept 25: `focus_line()`, `heads_up_notes()` and the fixed strings in `render()` in `remediation/render.py`, plus anything changed in `remediation/templates.py`.

The automated scope test doesn't replace this review. It only catches phrases on a list and can't judge clinical scope.

**Also:** you last said you're not showing it to the study group this week. Sharing it at all would mean relaxing the "local only" rule, and that's your call when you're ready.

Tell me when you've confirmed the reviewer's background and the changed wording has been checked, and I'll mark the review done.
